bullets: Set the vision and roadmap. Define and drive the strategy for APC, starting with the near-term goal of reaching feature parity with Astro Hosted.
Write the requirements. Specify a complex distributed platform that serves platform administrators, platform engineers, data engineers and AI teams.
Build alongside engineering. Work with R&D from design through release, including the infrastructure decisions that shape the product: Kubernetes, cloud environments…
Listen to our most strategic customers. Engage executives and technical leaders on their security, compliance, certification and central-management needs, and use what you learn…
Balance the few and the many. Weigh specific customer demands against a committed roadmap that serves the broader customer base. Push back where necessary, and work with…
